newsitem.title: USA: Philippine Long Distance to issue $500 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Long Distance to issue $500 mln in debt.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co is expected to issue $500 million in a two-tranche global debt offering on Tuesday, syndicate sources said.
The first part, a $200 million 10-year noncallable issue, is seen pricing at a spread of 160 to 165 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, the sources said.
The second tranche, a $300 million 20-year noncallable issue is seen pricing at a spread of 170 to 175 basis points over Treasuries, they added.
The deal is expected to be jointly underwritten by Goldman, Sachs & Co Inc and Citicorp, they said.
The global debt offering is rated Ba2/BB-plus, they added.
Philippine Long Distance, based in Makati City, furnishes telephone services in the Philippines.
